name: Obsidian Orb Ship Docked at a Cloud Harbor
description: A sleek obsidian sphere spaceship gently docking onto a floating harbor of clouds, ladder of light extends, surrounding clouds swirl with aurora-like ribbons, sunrise breaking through.
prompt: Obsidian orb spaceship smoothly docking onto a cloud harbor, light ladder extending, clouds swirling with pastel ribbons, early morning sun breaking through, vast sky, high contrast, sci‑fi fantasy, ultra-detailed, cinematic.
caption: Dock your dreams among the clouds 🚢☁️ Step onto a floating harbor where the ship of obsidian glides.
